column1: # 1B.2: the review of the merge's 116 clean-merged both-changed files (PLAN.md r46a §7.2 row 1B.2), merge 738e3400f of
# the cut e95d0bff3 and v1.4.0 (83fb95624), base 74d0c72fd. Schema of plans/stone-1a/clean-hunks-sg.tsv.
# Hunks: one row per hunk of `git diff -U0 738e3400f^1 738e3400f -- <file>` (what v1.4.0 brought into the fork's file;
# upstream_commit = its blame in ^74d0c72fd..738e3400f, or the pickaxe of a removed line) and of `git diff -U0
# 738e3400f^2 738e3400f -- <file>` (what the fork keeps against v1.4.0's file; upstream_commit = fork:<sha>), plus a row
# for any finding no hunk holds. line = the hunk's first line in 738e3400f:<file>. Every row read, hunk by hunk (TD
# D43's granularity at or above it: class 1 files, mixed, hunk by hunk too). No clean-merged file was edited in 1B.1:
# Tiers (the 2.2.8 rule): A a lock, a release, a yield or a held-lock precondition; S a class 1/2 or exception file; G a
# scope a Self-Correction Log entry governs, or a top-level/test scope in a governed file; L the rest.
# Groups: r1 terminal core (17 files), r2 C API, headers, examples, Doxyfile (37), r3 fonts, renderer, CLI, libraries
# (23), r4 apprt seams, config, input, inspector, os, misc (32), rb the seven build files (7, with 1B.3). Reviewed by
# R1B's nested reviewers (r1, r3, r4 Opus 5.5; r2 Sonnet 5.5) and R1B (rb); notes in the step's scratch.
# disposition: keep | adapted (adapted on the branch; says how) | fix (fix = the commit) | later (fix = the step and
#   the exact item; compile-only mismatches the step's compile reports anyway; no behaviour change is later).
